propositions: Proposed deterministic criteria for canonical section headings reject valid historical tickets with equivalent semantic content expressed through non-standard section names or inline specifications
Placeholder phrase detectors (e.g., 'check if') flag mechanically decidable conditional work as deferred design, causing false positives on bounded conditional tasks with complete specifications
Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers are not universally present in closed tickets with precise behavioral oracles and passing plan-review attestations
Read-only analysis and operational work tickets with empty file_impact and explicit no-edit contracts are rejected by blanket edit-set requirements
AC conjunction counts cannot reliably distinguish between bundled independent deliverables and atomic cross-surface invariants without semantic analysis
Testing section presence triggers false negatives for negative-scenario requirements when the work is mechanical or non-user-facing
